expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a 10-minute limit logged members out mid-checkout and lost
their pantry orders, which is why the limit is 30 minutes.
expectations.evidence: The message says members on slow mobile connections "were logged out before they could confirm it, and lost what they had picked," explains that "The limit went up to 30 minutes," warns that 10 minutes would bring back lost orders, and asks before changing it.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/sessions.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/sessions.md at step 6; first edit at step None
